text:
People Ops: Heads-up — final logistics for Wed's backend SWE loop. Candidate needs a quiet room (shared office booked) + Zoom. Can reviewers confirm access and scoring details? :calendar:

Maria T: I can take interview lead and run the zoom. Link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 — will post to the event.

Samir P: Quick Q on timing — is this still 30m interview + 15m debrief?

People Ops: Slight tweak: 25m interview, 10m quick notes in room, 10m post-call debrief. Total 45m block. We standardized to 1-4 scoring (1 = miss, 4 = exceeds) — see short rubric below.

Emily C: Can you paste the rubric snippet? I only have old 1-5 scale saved.

People Ops: Sure — copy paste: ```Scoring quick guide:
1 - insufficient / red flag
2 - meets some expectations, concerns
3 - solid / would pass for team
4 - exceptional / strong hire
```

Jamal R: Are we doing shared notes in the doc during interview or only debrief? I prefer quick bullets live so nothing is lost.

Maria T: I'll host shared Google doc. During the 25m interview I'll jot bullets, then we'll move to the quiet room for 10m to finalize scores. Please add one-line anchors under each competency: "System design", "Debugging", "Communication".

Samir P: Got it. Also want to calibrate on anchors: for System design a 3 should mean clear tradeoffs + scaling tradeoffs sketched, 2 = basic design with gaps.

People Ops: Good anchor. Add to doc: https://docs.google.com/example (edit access granted to interviewers).

Recruiting Bot: Reminder: Candidate NDA + background check completed. Calendar event updated with Zoom + doc link.

Emily C: One more — quiet room access: front desk code is 4312, sign-in required. People Ops, can you confirm the door is booked?

People Ops: Yes room "Quiet-3" reserved 30m before through 30m after. Front desk notified. I'll DM security to confirm entry.

Jamal R: Perfect. I'll be there 10m early to set up the doc and test audio.

Samir P: Thanks everyone. Small ask — during debrief let's capture one-line hire/no-hire and the top 2 signal reasons. Makes downstream debriefs faster.

People Ops: Love that. Adding to agenda: 1) Quick consensus (hire/no hire/hold) 2) Top 2 signals 3) Any follow-ups. See you Wed. :thumbsup:
